derivation.method: Remove provider PBR materials and textures; Import the provider OBJ geometry (Y-up to Z-up, -Z forward; material library and texture maps not loaded) and export GLB; Validate mesh; weld coincident vertices; dissolve degenerates; recalculate normals; collapse decimation only when above target with validation between passes; triangulate and validate before measuring.
